Subject: TIA & SCCs alignment for HealthWorks integration

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the demo last week — we had good internal alignment and Legal asked me to surface a couple of items so we can scope the transfer-impact assessment (TIA) and confirm the export mechanism. Short list: 

- Can Redwood provide the finalized SCCs mapping (EU SCCs + UK IDTA / UK Addendum) you rely on for hosted customers? We need an explicit statement of which clauses are covered by which executed instruments.
- Subprocessor map: a consolidated CSV with ingress/egress locations and any onshore-cache fallback behavior (especially for the EU region).
- Evidence for key safeguards: HSM/KMS controls, retention and deletion SLA, and whether runtime traces are stored outside EU.

Legal would like these materials ahead of our procurement review on 6/1. If there are templated responses (we have a 1–2 page TIA questionnaire), please send them back with expected lead times for attestation or DocuSign.

Attaching the high-level questionnaire we use. Happy to hop on a quick call if that helps prioritize.

Best,
Emma

- We have a published SCC mapping doc but for customers with an active procurement we provide an annotated mapping that ties each requirement to our contract/controls. Laura will prepare the annotated version for HealthWorks.
- Subprocessor CSV: we can generate a scoped list (EU region + any global transient processors) and mark any processors that touch onshore-cache or routing.
- Evidence: Vivek will confirm KMS/HSM attestation material and whether runtime traces are persisted in EU-only logging buckets for your tenant.

Proposed timeline: annotated SCC mapping + subprocessor CSV by 5/27; filled TIA questionnaire and evidence pointers by 5/31; DocuSign path for the UK Addendum / execution week of 6/7 (if Legal is ready).

Can you confirm the procurement date is 6/1 and whether HealthWorks requires certified translation or notarization for the UK Addendum?

Thanks — Karthik

Action items (owner / ETA):
- Laura: Annotated SCC mapping (EU SCCs -> our standard DPA clauses) + UK Addendum notes (5/27 COB). Deliverable: PDF + changelog.
- Vivek: KMS/HSM evidence pack and confirmation of tenant-level log residency (5/31 EOD). If logs are configured multi-region, note fallback policies.

Key clarifications to include in annotated mapping: which subprocessors perform transient caching (edge/redis), which processors may originate traffic from non-EU control planes, and the explicit fallback sequence if an EU region becomes unavailable. Emma — attaching the scoped materials Laura prepared (sent from our side). High level next steps and timeline below so Legal can calendar the procurement path: 

1) By 5/27 — Annotated SCC mapping (EU SCCs + UK Addendum notes) and scoped subprocessor CSV (attached).
2) By 5/31 — TIA questionnaire answers + evidence pack pointers (KMS attestation, tenant log residency statement).
3) Week of 6/7 — We’ll send DocuSign envelope for the UK Addendum and any one-off carve-outs; expect 1–3 business days for signature assuming legal review.

DocuSign: I will open a preliminary envelope with the UK Addendum + annotated mapping as exhibit; link will be sent once procurement confirms signatories. For HealthWorks procurement on 6/1, please flag any items that must be escalated to our legal team before 6/1 so we can pre-clear them.

Quick answers to your earlier Qs:
- Notarization: Redwood does not typically notarize the UK Addendum; we can provide certified copies and a countersigned addendum. If HealthWorks requires notarization for local acceptance, confirm and we will route to Legal (note this typically adds 5–7 business days).
- Runtime traces: Vivek confirms tenant logs for EU customers are stored in EU buckets by default; we will include a short attestation for your review.

Sharing attachments now: healthworks_subprocessor_list_v1.csv, TIA-questionnaire-filled.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to the procurement review next week.

Karthik
